headline: 2 buses targeted: Bus caught fire at Mohakhali terminal in Dhaka
summary: This is the second bus fire in the capital within a single night, following a similar incident in Mirpur.
details: A Shohag Paribahan bus parked at Dhaka's Mohakhali bus terminal caught fire shortly before 1am on Sunday. Two units from the Tejgaon Fire Station were dispatched to the scene to control the blaze.
caption:
Two buses targeted in a single night. A Shohag Paribahan bus was set on fire at Mohakhali terminal.

A Shohag Paribahan bus parked at Dhaka's Mohakhali bus terminal caught fire shortly before 1am on Sunday. Two units from the Tejgaon Fire Station were dispatched to the scene to control the blaze.

headline_marked: 14 arrested after [[fresh attack on New Gini housing]] in Dhaka
headline: 14 arrested after fresh attack on New Gini housing in Dhaka
summary: Police detained 14 people following a brawl involving 100-150 armed individuals at the South Manikdi project.
details: Police have arrested 14 people following a fresh brawl at the New Gini Properties housing project in Dhaka’s South Manikdi.
Between 100 and 150 people armed with local weapons entered the project area on Saturday afternoon and engaged in a fight, according to the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP).
Three of those arrested were seriously injured and were transferred from Kurmitola Multicare Specialized Hospital to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for advanced treatment.
Cantonment police intervened to bring the situation under control and detained the suspects.
This is the second such incident at the property; the project was previously attacked, vandalized, and looted on September 26 over a similar dispute.
The previous attack also hit the ‘Brownfish’ studio of content creator Salman Muqtadir, which is based in the project.
A case was filed at Cantonment Police Station by Saiful Islam Bhuiyan, director of New Gini Properties, naming 13 people, including retired major general Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury.
So far, 11 people have been arrested in connection with the September 26 attack, with eight of them currently out on bail.
caption:
100-150 armed people stormed a housing project in Dhaka, leading to 14 arrests.

Police have arrested 14 people following a fresh brawl at the New Gini Properties housing project in Dhaka’s South Manikdi.

Between 100 and 150 people armed with local weapons entered the project area on Saturday afternoon and engaged in a fight, according to the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP).

Three of those arrested were seriously injured and were transferred from Kurmitola Multicare Specialized Hospital to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for advanced treatment.

Cantonment police intervened to bring the situation under control and detained the suspects.

This is the second such incident at the property; the project was previously attacked, vandalized, and looted on September 26 over a similar dispute.

The previous attack also hit the ‘Brownfish’ studio of content creator Salman Muqtadir, which is based in the project.

A case was filed at Cantonment Police Station by Saiful Islam Bhuiyan, director of New Gini Properties, naming 13 people, including retired major general Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury.

So far, 11 people have been arrested in connection with the September 26 attack, with eight of them currently out on bail.
